result.topic_en: A heavily revised philosophical draft arguing that sensory qualities are subjective, so only quantitative relations among phenomena can reveal how things are connected; it states the task of explaining nature as finding the connection of things from the connection of phenomena.

items.english: However, the quality of the features of sensible things (taste, warmth or cold) is something taken solely from our sensation.
That from which alone the connection of things can be recognized is therefore quantitative relations.

items.english: But this notion is itself already a result of our interpretation of what is given through the senses.
